note: Raises zombies (3 to 7) that follow the character and slam enemies; they have life, are hurt by enemy blows and area attacks, and are raised again when the skill is cast after they fall.

def.name: Raise Husk
def.description: Raises husks of the dead to fight beside you.

note: Summons a group of skeletons (3 to 8) that run at enemies and last twenty seconds.

def.name: Call Bonewalkers
def.description: Calls up a band of skeletons for twenty seconds.

note: Summons burning spirits (3 to 8) that rush at enemies for five seconds.

def.name: Call Furies
def.description: Calls up burning spirits that fly at your enemies.

note: A stone golem that fights beside the character and regenerates its life.

def.name: Stone Colossus
def.description: Raises a colossus of stone that regenerates your life.

note: A chaos golem that fights beside the character and lowers the physical damage taken.

def.name: Blight Colossus
def.description: Raises a colossus of blight that hardens you against blows.

note: A flame golem that throws fire at enemies and makes the character deal more damage.

def.name: Ember Colossus
def.description: Raises a colossus of embers that makes you hit harder.

note: An ice golem that fights beside the character and gives it critical strike chance and accuracy.

def.name: Rime Colossus
def.description: Raises a colossus of frost that sharpens your strikes.

note: A lightning golem that shoots enemies and quickens the character's attacks and casting.

def.name: Storm Colossus
def.description: Raises a colossus of storm that quickens you.

note: One carrion golem (the only golem) that fights beside the character: while it stands, the other minions deal added physical damage, and the golem deals 8% more damage for each of them near it (80% at most) and has more life.

def.name: Carrion Colossus
def.description: Raises a colossus of carrion that makes your other minions hit harder.

note: A relic that follows the character, shoots at enemies and regenerates the character's life.

def.name: Hallowed Relic
def.description: Raises a relic that fires holy light and mends you.

note: Two motes follow the character and hold part of its mana: one chills and one shocks the enemies near it; they set off traps and mines (each once in three seconds, and the mines arm again), and the character’s traps and mines deal 10% more damage.

def.name: Whirring Motes
def.description: Motes that chill and shock the enemies about them, and set off your traps and mines.

note: Raises the corpse of a defeated monster as a spectre: it is that monster, at the gem's level (31 to 80), with that monster's attack. The corpse is used up. One spectre at first, a second from the thirteenth level of the gem; it needs a corpse near.

def.name: Bind Shade
def.description: Raise a defeated monster as your own, with the attack it had in life.

note: Animates a normal or magic melee weapon lying on the ground within the item level the gem allows (9 at the first level, 100 at the last): the weapon is used up and a flying blade strikes with its damage and the gem's added damage, for 37 s. Rare and unique weapons are kept.

def.name: Wake Blades
def.description: Wake a weapon lying on the ground into a blade that fights for you.

note: Animates the armour and weapons lying on the ground (normal or magic ones that the character can spare, within the level the gem allows; none with gems in them), one piece for each cast, onto the one Guardian: it has what the pieces give it, a quarter of its life comes back with each new piece of armour, and a weapon makes it strike with that weapon's damage. It has no time limit, and if it falls the pieces are lost.

def.name: Wake Sentinel
def.description: Wakes the armour and arms you find into a warden that wears them.

note: Fires an arrow at the target place; when it lands the character is carried to it and a shadow archer is left where the character stood, for three seconds. It has a cooldown of three seconds and shares it with the other blink skills.

def.name: Shadow Quiver
def.description: Fire an arrow and follow it, leaving a shadow archer where you stood.

note: Fires an arrow that leaves a mirrored archer for three seconds.

def.name: Mirror Quiver
def.description: Leaves a mirrored archer that fires beside you.

note: Uses a corpse and up to four more about it: for five seconds, and one more for each extra corpse, the minions have more chance to block attacks and spells and recover life when they block. Only one offering at a time.

def.name: Bone Ward Rite
def.description: An offering of bone that raises your minions' guard.

note: Uses a corpse and up to four more about it: for five seconds, and one more for each extra corpse, the minions attack, cast and move faster. Only one offering at a time.

def.name: Flesh Surge Rite
def.description: An offering of flesh that quickens your minions.

note: Uses a corpse and up to four more about it: for five seconds, and one more for each extra corpse, the minions gain energy shield (4% of their life for each corpse), a share of their physical damage as chaos damage, and elemental resistances. Only one offering at a time.

def.name: Spirit Ward Rite
def.description: An offering of spirit that warms your minions' resolve.

note: The supported minions deal more damage.

def.name: Pack Fury
def.description: Minions deal more damage.

note: The supported minions have more life.

def.name: Hardy Pack
def.description: Minions have more life and last longer in a fight.

note: The supported minions strike and move faster.

def.name: Pack Haste
def.description: Minions strike and move faster.

note: The supported skill's minions are defensive: they stay close to the character and go for the enemies near it, take less damage, deal more damage to enemies near the character, and move faster. (No taunt on hit: monsters here do not pick minions.)

def.name: Warding Pack
def.description: Minions guard you: they stay close, take less damage, and hit harder near you.

note: The supported minions gain elemental resistances and a higher maximum, deal more elemental damage (not physical or chaos), and their hits expose the enemy to the element they dealt.

def.name: Elemental Pack
def.description: Minions shrug off the elements, hit harder with them and leave the enemy open to them.

note: The supported minions make the character stronger as they hit (folded into more minion damage and speed).

def.name: Frenzied Pack
def.description: Minions fight in a frenzy.

note: The supported minions burn the enemies near them for fire damage over time (it does not stack between minions) and burn themselves for 40% of their life a second, less their fire resistance.

def.name: Burning Pack
def.description: Minions are wreathed in fire that burns what is near, and them.
